key: ???: Oh, hello.
en: ???: Oh, hello.
ja: ???: あら、こんにちは。

key: Just come right on in, why don't you?
en: Just come right on in, why don't you?
ja: どうぞ、遠慮なく入って。

key: ???: No, sorry... I suppose I should be used to this.
en: ???: No, sorry... I suppose I should be used to this.
ja: ???: いえ、ごめんなさい……もう慣れっこのはずなんだけど。

key: Just, have the entire living room be a Gym-- why not.
en: Just, have the entire living room be a Gym-- why not.
ja: リビング全体がジムになる、それくらい別に構わないわよね。

key: Those contractors did a rush job in the first place and didn't even bother coming out for seconds!
en: Those contractors did a rush job in the first place and didn't even bother coming out for seconds!
ja: あの業者、最初から急ぎ仕事だったし、二度と顔も出さなかったんだから!

key: Not like we needed the work or anything...
en: Not like we needed the work or anything...
ja: 別に、工事なんて必要なかったのにね……

key: Bet they took one look at the place and begged for mercy from the Lord almighty on the spot.
en: Bet they took one look at the place and begged for mercy from the Lord almighty on the spot.
ja: きっと、ここを一目見て、その場で神様に許しを乞うたんでしょうよ。

key: ???: Sorry, you here for a League challenge?
en: ???: Sorry, you here for a League challenge?
ja: ???: ごめんなさい、リーグ挑戦で来たの?

key: The Gym Leader, Aya, is my daughter.
en: The Gym Leader, Aya, is my daughter.
ja: ジムリーダーのアヤは、うちの娘なの。

key: My name is Lana, and my husband is Tez.
en: My name is Lana, and my husband is Tez.
ja: わたしはラナ。夫はテズよ。

key: Nice to meet you, I guess.
en: Nice to meet you, I guess.
ja: よろしくね、たぶん。

key: LANA: AYA, YOU HAVE ANOTHER VISITOR!
en: LANA: AYA, YOU HAVE ANOTHER VISITOR!
ja: ラナ: アヤ、また お客さんよ!

key: AYA: OKAY, I'M A LITTLE BUSY RIGHT NOW.
en: AYA: OKAY, I'M A LITTLE BUSY RIGHT NOW.
ja: アヤ: わかった、今ちょっと忙しいんだけど。

key: LANA: Well, it's been a busy day.
en: LANA: Well, it's been a busy day.
ja: ラナ: まあ、今日は忙しい一日ね。

key: She's currently in battle with a different Trainer.
en: She's currently in battle with a different Trainer.
ja: 今、別のトレーナーとバトル中なの。

key: I suppose you're free to go and watch, if you'd like.
en: I suppose you're free to go and watch, if you'd like.
ja: よければ、見に行ってもいいのよ。

key: LANA: By the way, the machine behind me can be used to recover your Pokémon, if you need.
en: LANA: By the way, the machine behind me can be used to recover your Pokémon, if you need.
ja: ラナ: ちなみに、わたしの後ろの機械は、必要ならポケモンの回復に使えるわ。

key: I guess that's just a thing we're supposed to live with people doing in the living room.
en: I guess that's just a thing we're supposed to live with people doing in the living room.
ja: リビングで人がそういうことするのにも、慣れなきゃいけないってことね。

key: You know, they could stand to pay her more.
en: You know, they could stand to pay her more.
ja: それにしても、もっと給料払ってあげてもいいと思うんだけどね。

key: I keep telling her she should march on down to the Grand Hall and talk to someone about it, but...
en: I keep telling her she should march on down to the Grand Hall and talk to someone about it, but...
ja: グランドホールまで行って誰かに文句言ってきなさいって、いつも言ってるんだけど……

key: Kids these days are a little...
en: Kids these days are a little...
ja: 最近の子供って、ちょっと……

key: Well, you know.
en: Well, you know.
ja: まあ、わかるでしょ。

key: LANA: I'm so proud of Aya.
en: LANA: I'm so proud of Aya.
ja: ラナ: アヤのこと、本当に誇りに思ってるの。

key: You know with this as her job, she's supporting us all by herself.
en: You know with this as her job, she's supporting us all by herself.
ja: この仕事のおかげで、あの子ひとりで家族全員を支えてくれてるのよ。

key: She really is a wonderful daughter.
en: She really is a wonderful daughter.
ja: 本当に、素晴らしい娘だわ。

key: LANA: That green-haired boy is so rude.
en: LANA: That green-haired boy is so rude.
ja: ラナ: あの緑髪の子、本当に失礼だったわ。

key: I hope there won't be too many challengers like him...
en: I hope there won't be too many challengers like him...
ja: ああいう挑戦者があんまり多くないといいんだけど……

key: LANA: Can I help you?
en: LANA: Can I help you?
ja: ラナ: 何か用かしら?

key: Aya's no longer here. She left with that punky red hair kid.
en: Aya's no longer here. She left with that punky red hair kid.
ja: アヤはもういないの。あの赤髪のパンクな子と出かけちゃったから。

key: TEZ: Hey, heyheyhey--
en: TEZ: Hey, heyheyhey--
ja: テズ: おい、おいおいおい――

key: What the hell you doin'?
en: What the hell you doin'?
ja: 何やってんだ、お前?

key: That's personal space, get it?
en: That's personal space, get it?
ja: そこは俺のプライベート空間だぞ、わかるか?

key: Keep outta there.
en: Keep outta there.
ja: 入ってくるな。

key: LANA: Sorry!
en: LANA: Sorry!
ja: ラナ: ごめんなさいね!

key: He's very protective of his, you know.
en: He's very protective of his, you know.
ja: あの人、自分の場所にはすごく神経質なの。

key: "Man cave".
en: "Man cave".
ja: 「男の秘密基地」ってやつ。

key: You know how boys are...
en: You know how boys are...
ja: 男の子って、そういうものでしょ……

key: The machine seems to be unresponsive. A small port in the front is exposed.
en: The machine seems to be unresponsive. A small port in the front is exposed.
ja: 機械は反応していないようだ。前面に小さな差し込み口が見える。

key: Plug in the Data Chip?
en: Plug in the Data Chip?
ja: データチップを差し込みますか?

key: \PN inserted the Data Chip into the port...
en: \PN inserted the Data Chip into the port...
ja: \PNはデータチップを差し込み口に差した……

key: LANA: There! It listened!
en: LANA: There! It listened!
ja: ラナ: ほら! ちゃんと言うこと聞いたわ!

key: Guess you're not so bad after all!
en: Guess you're not so bad after all!
ja: あんた、意外と悪くないのね!

key: LANA: ...What now.
en: LANA: ...What now.
ja: ラナ: ……今度は何よ。

key: Like, really, what does that thing think it's doing here?
en: Like, really, what does that thing think it's doing here?
ja: ってか、マジであれ、ここで何のつもりなの?

key: Shoo! Get out of here! Go back to wherever you came from!
en: Shoo! Get out of here! Go back to wherever you came from!
ja: しっ! あっちに行って! 来たところに帰りなさい!

key: LANA: It's just one thing after another, isn't it...
en: LANA: It's just one thing after another, isn't it...
ja: ラナ: 次から次へと、本当にキリがないわね……

key: LANA: Oh, for fuck's sake! WHY?!
en: LANA: Oh, for fuck's sake! WHY?!
ja: ラナ: もう、勘弁してよ! なんでよ!?

key: You probably shouldn't touch it without anyone else here...
en: You probably shouldn't touch it without anyone else here...
ja: 誰もいないところで、それに触らない方がいいと思うけど……

key: RECOVERY UNIT INITIATED
en: RECOVERY UNIT INITIATED
ja: 回復ユニット、起動

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: LANA: NO NO NO YOU ARE CERTAINLY NOT GOING BACK THERE WHILE RIDING THAT THING, YOU STOP THIS INSTANT!
en: LANA: NO NO NO YOU ARE CERTAINLY NOT GOING BACK THERE WHILE RIDING THAT THING, YOU STOP THIS INSTANT!
ja: ラナ: だめだめだめ、そんなものに乗ったまま戻るなんて絶対に許さないから、今すぐやめなさい!

key: LANA: All right, listen here, you stupid flashy hunk of mechanical junkstuff.
en: LANA: All right, listen here, you stupid flashy hunk of mechanical junkstuff.
ja: ラナ: いいから聞きなさい、このバカみたいにピカピカな金属のガラクタが。

key: You were basically JUST installed.
en: You were basically JUST installed.
ja: あんた、設置されたばっかりでしょうが。

key: You have NO BUSINESS going around breaking already!
en: You have NO BUSINESS going around breaking already!
ja: もう壊れるとか、そんな権利ないんだから!

key: Now you fix yourself RIGHT NOW or you're--
en: Now you fix yourself RIGHT NOW or you're--
ja: 今すぐ自分で直しなさい、さもないと――

key: Grounded, or-- whatever it is machines don't like!
en: Grounded, or-- whatever it is machines don't like!
ja: 外出禁止、とか――機械が嫌がることなら何でもしてやるから!

key: STARLY: Stara-?
en: STARLY: Stara-?
ja: ムックル: ムック?

key: Presumably the Starly already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
en: Presumably the Starly already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
ja: このムックルには、どこかに飼い主がいるようだ。

key: PIKACHU: Chuuuu...
en: PIKACHU: Chuuuu...
ja: ピカチュウ: ピカ……

key: Presumably the Pikachu already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
en: Presumably the Pikachu already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
ja: このピカチュウには、どこかに飼い主がいるようだ。

key: BUDEW: Buhh...
en: BUDEW: Buhh...
ja: スボミー: ブー……

key: Presumably the Budew already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
en: Presumably the Budew already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
ja: このスボミーには、どこかに飼い主がいるようだ。

key: LANA: A little life advice?
en: LANA: A little life advice?
ja: ラナ: ちょっとした人生のアドバイス。

key: If anyone ever asks you to convert your house into a Gym...
en: If anyone ever asks you to convert your house into a Gym...
ja: もし誰かに、家をジムに改造してくれって頼まれたら……

key: Punch them in the face and run far, far away.
en: Punch them in the face and run far, far away.
ja: 顔を殴って、遠くへ、遠くへ逃げなさい。

key: LANA: ...
en: LANA: ...
ja: ラナ: ……

key: UM, EXCUSE ME, WHAT ARE YOU DOING RIDING THAT POKÉMON INSIDE MY HOUSE?!
en: UM, EXCUSE ME, WHAT ARE YOU DOING RIDING THAT POKÉMON INSIDE MY HOUSE?!
ja: ちょっと、うちの中でそのポケモンに乗って、何してるつもり!?

key: HAVE YOU NOT SEEN ME SUFFER ENOUGH?!
en: HAVE YOU NOT SEEN ME SUFFER ENOUGH?!
ja: わたしがもう十分苦しんでるのが、見てわからないの!?

key: MAKE. IT. STOP.
en: MAKE. IT. STOP.
ja: や。め。て。

key: LANA: PLEASE. ALL OF YOU GET OUT BEFORE YOU BREAK EVERYTHING AND THEN SOME.
en: LANA: PLEASE. ALL OF YOU GET OUT BEFORE YOU BREAK EVERYTHING AND THEN SOME.
ja: ラナ: お願い。みんな、何もかも壊し尽くす前に、出て行って。

key: Oh, lord, what did I do to deserve this?
en: Oh, lord, what did I do to deserve this?
ja: ああ、神様、わたしが一体何をしたっていうの?

key: LANA: Another surprise like that, and I'll be popping aneurysms like prescription pills...
en: LANA: Another surprise like that, and I'll be popping aneurysms like prescription pills...
ja: ラナ: また同じような驚きがあったら、動脈りゅうが薬みたいにぽんぽん出てきちゃうわ……

key: LANA: What are you still doing here?
en: LANA: What are you still doing here?
ja: ラナ: まだここにいたの?

key: Haven't you caused enough damage already?
en: Haven't you caused enough damage already?
ja: もう十分、被害を出したんじゃないの?

key: AZURILL: Azuzuzuzu?
en: AZURILL: Azuzuzuzu?
ja: ルリリ: ルリリ?

key: Presumably the Azurill already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
en: Presumably the Azurill already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
ja: このルリリには、どこかに飼い主がいるようだ。

key: HAXORUS: GRAAAAGGGH!!!
en: HAXORUS: GRAAAAGGGH!!!
ja: オノノクス: ガアアアアアッ!!!

key: Presumably the Haxorus already belongs to a Trainer... one hopes.
en: Presumably the Haxorus already belongs to a Trainer... one hopes.
ja: このオノノクスにも、どこかに飼い主がいる……はずだ、多分。

key: SPOINK: Spoink Spoink Spoink Spoink!!
en: SPOINK: Spoink Spoink Spoink Spoink!!
ja: バネブー: バネブー バネブー バネブー!!

key: Presumably the Spoink already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
en: Presumably the Spoink already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
ja: このバネブーには、どこかに飼い主がいるようだ。

key: DONPHAN: Doooooooooon!
en: DONPHAN: Doooooooooon!
ja: ドンファン: ドオオオオオオン!

key: Is it scared to get down?
en: Is it scared to get down?
ja: 降りるのが怖いんだろうか?

key: Hopefully its Trainer finds it.
en: Hopefully its Trainer finds it.
ja: 飼い主が見つけてくれるといいけど。

key: EMOLGA: Emol?
en: EMOLGA: Emol?
ja: エモンガ: エモ?

key: Presumably the Emolga already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
en: Presumably the Emolga already belongs to a Trainer somewhere.
ja: このエモンガには、どこかに飼い主がいるようだ。

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ! ジムまでたどり着いたみたいだね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムはグランドホールに直結していて、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらえるんだ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: AME: You're in the Wasteland, right? We just installed this machine there and the signal's a little wonky.
en: AME: You're in the Wasteland, right? We just installed this machine there and the signal's a little wonky.
ja: アメ: 今、荒れ地にいるんだよね? そこにこの機械を設置したばっかりで、電波がちょっと不安定なんだ。

key: Oh well. Aya's new as a Leader, as you know.
en: Oh well. Aya's new as a Leader, as you know.
ja: まあいいや。知っての通り、アヤはまだ新人リーダーでね。

key: Unfortunately, that means I don't know a whole lot about her.
en: Unfortunately, that means I don't know a whole lot about her.
ja: だから残念ながら、彼女についてはあんまり詳しくないんだ。

key: What I can tell you is that I know she favors Double Battles, and she fights using the Wasteland itself.
en: What I can tell you is that I know she favors Double Battles, and she fights using the Wasteland itself.
ja: ただ、ダブルバトルを好むことと、荒れ地そのものを使って戦うことは知ってるよ。

key: You might have noticed when getting there, but that area can be a little unpredictable.
en: You might have noticed when getting there, but that area can be a little unpredictable.
ja: ここに来る時に気づいたかもしれないけど、あのエリアはちょっと予測がつかない。

key: Wasteland attacks can inflict random statuses or have other effects.
en: Wasteland attacks can inflict random statuses or have other effects.
ja: 荒れ地の攻撃は、ランダムな状態異常やその他の効果を引き起こすことがあるんだ。

key: So be careful, or else you'll get wasted.
en: So be careful, or else you'll get wasted.
ja: だから気をつけて、じゃないと「荒れ果てる」ことになるよ。

key: Sorry, couldn't resist.
en: Sorry, couldn't resist.
ja: ごめん、つい言いたくなっちゃって。

key: Anyway, the gunk that coats Byxbysion is kind of squishy and jello-like.
en: Anyway, the gunk that coats Byxbysion is kind of squishy and jello-like.
ja: それはさておき、ビクスビシオンを覆ってるドロドロは、ゼリーみたいにぶよぶよしてる。

key: Because of that, it eats up some Ground-type attacks, which helps her a lot.
en: Because of that, it eats up some Ground-type attacks, which helps her a lot.
ja: そのせいで、じめん技の一部を吸収しちゃうから、それが彼女にとって大きな助けになってる。

key: Try focusing down one target at a time with an emphasis on her Pokémon's secondary types.
en: Try focusing down one target at a time with an emphasis on her Pokémon's secondary types.
ja: 彼女のポケモンのサブタイプを意識しながら、一体ずつ集中攻撃してみるといい。

key: If you play your match-ups well, you can definitely win.
en: If you play your match-ups well, you can definitely win.
ja: 相性をうまく使えば、絶対に勝てるはずだよ。

key: LANA: Um, excuse me, was this machine installed for the sole purpose of telling people how to beat my daughter?
en: LANA: Um, excuse me, was this machine installed for the sole purpose of telling people how to beat my daughter?
ja: ラナ: ちょっと、この機械って、うちの娘の倒し方を教えるためだけに設置されたの?

key: How is that fair?
en: How is that fair?
ja: それって、フェアだと思う?

key: Turn that thing off at once! Now!
en: Turn that thing off at once! Now!
ja: 今すぐそれ、切りなさい! 今すぐ!

key: AME: Um, hahaha... Busted.
en: AME: Um, hahaha... Busted.
ja: アメ: ええと、ははは……バレたか。

key: Good luck, \PN!
en: Good luck, \PN!
ja: 頑張って、\PN!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールでは、誰も出ないようだ……

key: TEZ: You need somethin'?
en: TEZ: You need somethin'?
ja: テズ: 何か用か?

key: All you League punks think it's fine to just walk all up in private property like this?
en: All you League punks think it's fine to just walk all up in private property like this?
ja: リーグの奴らってのは、こうやって私有地に勝手に入り込んで平気なのか?

key: If you hadn't noticed, the gym is in the other direction.
en: If you hadn't noticed, the gym is in the other direction.
ja: 気づいてないかもしれないけど、ジムは反対方向だぞ。

key: Now buzz off.
en: Now buzz off.
ja: さっさと消えろ。

key: Leave me to my business.
en: Leave me to my business.
ja: 俺の邪魔をするな。

key: TEZ: What the hell do you want?
en: TEZ: What the hell do you want?
ja: テズ: 一体何の用だ?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
